items.text: Trace untrusted input (arguments, environment variables, file names and contents, config) into subprocess calls, shell strings, file paths, deserializers and format strings on the changed lines.
Check new or changed file handling for path traversal, unsafe temporary files, permissions, symlink races (TOCTOU) and partial writes.
Check for secrets, tokens or credentials in the diff, unsafe defaults, disabled verification, and weakened authorization checks.
